# YOTSUI KIMONO DESIGN

> > Yotsui Kimono Design Kenkyu-jo: Traditional Japanese kimono design studio based in Ishikawa Prefecture, specializing in artisan dyeing and craft techniques.

Founded by Ken Yotsui, a Kanazawa-born kimono designer recognized by the Japan Craft Association (Nihon Kogei-kai), the studio creates traditional craft kimono with award-winning designs. The company is located in Nonoichi-shi, Ishikawa Prefecture, a region renowned for Japanese traditional crafts.

## Key Topics

- Kimono design and dyeing
- Ken Yotsui (founder and designer)
- Ishikawa Prefecture traditional crafts
- Japan Craft Association (Nihon Kogei-kai)
- Kanazawa city artisan culture
- Traditional Japanese textile techniques
- Artisan craftsmanship
- Ishikawa Pref. Traditional Craft Exhibition
- Japanese craft awards and achievements
- Nonoichi-shi, Ishikawa
- Cultural heritage preservation
